# ClawFetch MCP Server

> MCP server providing web intelligence tools for AI agents via ClawFetch API with x402 micropayments.

## Tools

- fetch_url: Fetch URL as clean markdown ($0.001)
- render_page: JS-render pages via stealth browser ($0.002)
- extract_data: Structured data from 17+ site types ($0.003)
- research_topic: Multi-source research with citations ($0.01)
- check_domains: Domain availability check ($0.002)
- suggest_domains: Domain name suggestions ($0.002)
- list_extractors: Available data extractors ($0.001)
- health_check: API status (free)
- wallet_info: Payment wallet address (free)

## Setup

Requires CLAWFETCH_PRIVATE_KEY env var (Ethereum key for USDC payments on Base).

## Transport

Supports stdio (default) and HTTP (Streamable HTTP) transports.
